blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court allowed the House prosecution panel on Tuesday to withdraw three of the four articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte, leaving allegations of unexplained wealth and nondisclosure of assets as the sole remaining basis for the trial.
